Salary is well above his €30-40k floor.

## TIER 3 — strong signal, aggregator-verified only, direct ATS page not fetchable

**13. Spyrosoft | Forward Deployed Engineer (OpenAI)** — Poland Remote, "Fluent English - C1", Polish not required, **zł110–150/hour** (~€25–35/h, contract-shaped), posted July 9. https://careers.spyro-soft.com/jobs/8044521-forward-deployed-engineer-openai — exact target title, English-only, and an hourly rate that works with his Partita IVA.

**14. Space Inch | AI Engineer – EU** — "Europe", with the eligibility line "This is a B2B only position for EU applicants outside of Croatia." €5,100–6,800/month, freelance/full-time, published 7 April 2026. https://apply.workable.com/spaceinch/j/3D52735501/ — B2B-only across the EU is precisely his situation, and the rate is roughly double his stated expectation.

**15. Action1 | Applied AI Engineer** — "Worldwide", fully remote, mid-level, full-time, published 3 June 2026. https://apply.workable.com/action1/j/950A91C0A2/ — one of very few genuinely worldwide-remote AI roles found.

## What I tried and what killed things

Rotated all thirteen assigned query vocabularies across Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, join.com, Personio, euremotejobs, Himalayas, RemoteRocketship and Wellfound, plus country-specific sweeps for DE/NL/FR/ES/PT/IE/Nordics/PL/Baltics/AT/BE/IT/GR.

Two tooling limits worth knowing for the next run:
- **apply.workable.com serves metadata only** to a non-JS fetcher — every Workable posting came back as title-and-nothing-else. The workaround that succeeded was finding the same posting mirrored on euremotejobs.com or RemoteRocketship, which carry the full text plus the direct Workable apply link. That's how #14 and #15 got verified.
- **join.com returns HTTP 410 for dead postings**, which is a clean liveness signal. It killed Bifrost Studios, Vetaion, Convact, Particula, NEWWORK, Enterprise Bot, alago and syte outright.

Dropped after reading the actual posting: **exmox** (5+ yrs), **commercetools** (5+ yrs), **Smartsheet** (6–10 yrs, €87.5-112.5k), **Lovable** (5+ yrs), **XO Life** (PhD or MSc+5), **Hightouch** (4+ yrs sales), **Corelight** (North America, 5+), **Appfire** (Senior). Killed on language: **SevenLab** (Dutch), **Roger** (German), **AMDT** (German is team language), **botario** (fluent German), **Talkdesk DACH** (bilingual German). Killed on geography: **Sezzle** (LatAm), **The Global Talent Co.** (Latin America), **Human Intelligence** (Philippines/Vietnam/LatAm), **Huzzle** (United Kingdom only), **Alphapet** (Germany or UK only), **Talkdesk** and **Aircall FDE** (both Remote – United States), **Quillbot** (India), **Future** (USD 215-250k, US). Killed as closed boards: **DoiT** (all four EU postings returned the 83-job index), **Integral** and **Openprovider** (Personio 404), **Zartis**, **BURGA**, **Welocalize Spain**, **Actian agentic** (Lever 404). **Binalyze** had a real entry-level EU posting but its application deadline was 22 June 2026.
